title: Momentum as Residual-Driven Multiplier Correction for Deep Learning Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2608.12925v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Momentum-based optimizers are widely used in modern deep learning, yet the relations among momentum recursion, update geometry, and acceleration remain only partially understood. We develop an $\textbf{A}$DMM-$\textbf{I}$nspired $\textbf{M}$omentum (AIM) framework based on residual-penalty variable splitting, which interprets momentum as a multiplier-like correction driven by the splitting residual. AIM recovers the exponential moving average of gradients from an ADMM-style multiplier update and separates two mechanisms that are usually intertwined in practical optimizers: the residual penalty determines the update geometry, whereas the approximation of the objective-related subproblem determines the acceleration form. Building on AIM, we propose $\textbf{R}$elativistic $\textbf{A}$daptive gradient $\textbf{D}$escent with $\textbf{A}$ccelerated $\textbf{R}$esidual (RADAR), which combines relativistic adaptive geometry, decoupled residual

translated_title: 动量作为深度学习优化中残差驱动的乘子校正
translated_abstract: 基于动量的优化器在现代深度学习中广泛使用，但动量递归、更新几何和加速之间的关系仍仅被部分理解。我们开发了一个基于残差惩罚变量分裂的ADMM启发动量（AIM）框架，该框架将动量解释为由分裂残差驱动的类乘子校正。AIM从ADMM风格的乘子更新中恢复了梯度的指数移动平均，并分离了实际优化器中通常交织的两种机制：残差惩罚决定更新几何，而目标相关子问题的近似决定加速形式。基于AIM，我们提出了相对论自适应梯度下降与加速残差（RADAR），它结合了相对论自适应几何、解耦残差
tldr: 该论文提出了AIM框架，将动量解释为残差驱动的乘子校正，并基于此设计了RADAR优化器，分离了更新几何与加速机制，提升了深度学习优化性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the AIM framework that interprets momentum as residual-driven multiplier correction, and introduces the RADAR optimizer that separates update geometry from acceleration mechanisms to improve deep learning optimization.
